# 10 · The Observatory
Science tempo as identity: per-tech and per-age payoffs, age-lead as a weapon. The
per-age scaler shape is the real identity and is barely used.
Wins by: First Into the Age (every era) · The Deepest Learning · the curtain itself.

## Æra I
- Tech: Letters
- Orders: The Almanac · Star-Gazers (a mountain in the borders)
- Religion: Star Readers · Keeper of the Calendar (the every-N-turns shape → see 19)
- Deeds: First Into the Age (recurring)

## Æra II
- Orders: The Lyceum (a tech pays a turn of culture — the new derived grant) · Scholars' Stipend
- Wonders: The Great Library
- Deeds: The Scholar's Wager · The Library of the Realm

## Æra III
- Tech: Education (the marquee) · The Examination Hall
- Orders: ▢ ________ (a per-age scaler: +X per age you lead the median?)
- Doctrines: The Encyclopaedia
- Wonders: The House of Wisdom
- Deeds: The Deepest Learning · The Encyclopaedia (endeavour)

## Æra IV
- Tech: ▢ ________ (what does the last science DO besides end the game — the mastery question)
- Orders: ▢ ________
- Deeds: ▢ ________ · finishing the chart as the theme's Opus

## Gaps
Mostly flat adders today; the age-lead mechanics (cost bands punish laggards) do the work
and nothing celebrates them.
